text:
Sofia: Hey folks — PR #17001 (feature/kv-prefetch) is currently blocked by CI. Failing intermittently on e2e/smoke/login in shard-12 with a timeout. I added a debug commit (logs only). Can someone give me an approval if this looks like infra noise, and advice whether we should rerun targeted shard or update anything? Logs pasted below.

CI-bot: Build 17001.4 — test e2e/smoke/login failed (exit code 1). Logs: `Timeout waiting for element .login-button (5000ms)` — full log:```[2026-03-17T12:01:34Z] INFO starting test e2e/smoke/login
[2026-03-17T12:01:38Z] DEBUG click .username
[2026-03-17T12:01:39Z] DEBUG click .password
[2026-03-17T12:01:44Z] ERROR Timeout waiting for element .login-button (5000ms)
[2026-03-17T12:01:44Z] INFO test failed
```

Matt: I can take a look and approve if it's not a behavior change. How often is this happening?

Sofia: ~1/6 runs over the past 48h. I triggered 3 reruns earlier; 2 passed, 1 failed. No code changes in test besides the debug logs.

Ryan: That pattern smells like timing flakiness. Are we on the same browser image across shards? Sometimes shard 12 has higher load on runners.

Jess: +1 to targeted rerun first. We have the targeted rerun CLI: `/ci rerun --pr 17001 --shards 12` — avoids wasting queue. If it reproduces, we can dig deeper.

Sam: If it keeps flaking, I'd prefer adding a small wait in the test instead of snapshot updates. Snapshots here would be wrong: the assertions are about UI presence not visual diffs. Increasing wait from 5000ms -> 8000ms or polling until visible is safer.

Linda: Agree with Sam. Also we should avoid changing test semantics for product behavior. Could it be that the preflight auth token fetch is slower intermittently? The logs show `click .password` then a 5s gap. Do we have any recent infra changes?

Sofia: No infra change on our end. I did notice one runner in the last failing job had higher CPU. I can annotate the job: https://ci.internal/jobs/17001.4/executors

Matt: If it's infra, we can mark as flaky in the PR description and ask SRE to investigate after we merge. But first we need an approval so the PR isn't blocked. If the change is purely perf/optimistic caching, I'm fine approving.

Sofia: The change is a small refactor of the prefetch path and a nil-check; not related to login page. No behavior changes.

Matt: OK, I reviewed the diff quickly — looks safe. Approved from me. :thumbsup:

Jess: I'll trigger the targeted rerun now.

CI-bot: `/ci rerun --pr 17001 --shards 12` queued by Jess — rerun id 17001.5.

Sofia: Thanks Jess — will wait for results. If it flakes again, I'll open a short follow-up to add an explicit wait or guard.

CI-bot: Rerun 17001.5 started.

[~8 minutes later]

CI-bot: Rerun 17001.5 — shard-12 ✅ passed. All other jobs green. Merge can proceed.

Sofia: Thanks everyone — merging now. I'll file a brief post-merge note to track this shard's runner perf and ask SRE to watch for repeated CPU spikes.

Matt: Thanks — and good call on targeted rerun to save queue.

Ryan: If it recurs, we can add a short `pollUntilVisible()` helper in tests to reduce flakiness across the board.

Sofia: Noted. Closing the loop. :white_check_mark:
